name: Our home
description: The real house: footprint, roof and terrain levels from official geodata (Datenquelle: Bayerische Vermessungsverwaltung, CC BY 4.0), windows and levels estimated from street-level photos, the souterrain rooms from the owner's room measurements. Terrain is simplified to levelled areas and slopes. Heights are relative to the ground-floor finished floor (0).

apartments.name: Souterrain apartment
apartments.description: Two entrances: through the stair hall, and from the souterrain patio into the corridor. Patio on the east side, garden on the north side.

entrances.name: Stair hall entrance
entrances.description: From the house's entrance on the ground floor down the stair into the stair hall.

entrances.name: Patio entrance
entrances.description: From the lane through the gate at the north end of the souterrain patio, down a straight flight of seven natural-stone steps (walking west) between rubble side walls, and across the paved landing to the exterior door at the east end of the corridor.
